name: camayoc_verifications_without_falsifier
description: verification-and-liveness Q2: verifications carrying no falsifier — assertions wearing a verification's clothes. Structurally empty for gated writes; non-empty only for data that entered before the M1 shape or around it, which is exactly what it is for.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label WHERE { ?verification a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?verification aegis:falsifier ?f } } ORDER BY ?label
